name: Protect main
_note_commit_message_pattern: Removed 2026-05-25: commit_message_pattern is Organization-tier only (not available for individual / free public repos). Enforce Conventional Commits via commitlint + Husky locally and a commitlint GitHub Action in CI. If you have a GitHub Enterprise org, add the rule back at the org-ruleset level.
_note_required_status_checks: Add the required_status_checks rule only AFTER your first CI run has landed on main and you know the exact context names. Trying to require a context that doesn't exist yet blocks all merges. Example shape: { "type": "required_status_checks", "parameters": { "strict_required_status_checks_policy": true, "required_status_checks": [ { "context": "node" } ] } }
